items.t: North Vancouver real estate market stats

faq.a: A District of North Vancouver neighbourhood around Delbrook Avenue and West Queens Road — one of the five neighbourhoods (with Norwood/Queens, Upper Delbrook, Carisbrooke and Braemar) in the District's North Lonsdale–Delbrook planning area, anchored by the Delbrook Community Recreation Centre at 851 West Queens Road.

faq.q: Which schools serve a Delbrook address?
faq.a: Catchments are address-based in SD44. The elementary schools beside the area are École Braemar Elementary (3600 Mahon Avenue) and Carisbrooke Elementary (510 Carisbrooke Road East), with Carson Graham Secondary (2145 Jones Avenue) the secondary school south of the neighbourhood — confirm the exact address with SD44.

Route 249 runs via Westview Drive, Delbrook Avenue and Montroyal Boulevard to Lonsdale Quay (continuing as a 246 downtown trip), route 246 runs on Delbrook Avenue, and route 232 runs on West Queens Road.

faq.q: What is happening at 600 West Queens Road?
faq.a: The District is redeveloping its former recreation centre lands (the Delbrook Lands) under Bylaws 8397–8399: a neighbourhood park on the northern portion and a four-storey building with low-to-moderate-income rental housing and a seniors' care facility on the southern portion.

faq.q: Can a Delbrook house lot hold a suite or a coach house?
faq.a: Yes. Under District Zoning Bylaw 3210, Section 525, an R2 lot may hold one principal dwelling, one secondary suite and one coach house, and since June 2024 three units total are permitted on single-family lots within the Urban Containment Boundary; provincial SSMUH rules also apply by lot size and bus-stop distance.
